query: UPDATE packages p1 SET trackingNumber = NULL WHERE trackingNumber IS NOT NULL AND trackingNumber != '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT trackingNumber, MIN(id) as min_id FROM packages WHERE trackingNumber IS NOT NULL AND trackingNumber != '' GROUP BY trackingNumber HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) p2 WHERE p1.trackingNumber = p2.trackingNumber AND p1.id > p2.min_id);
